messages:
sam: Quick sync — starting HW Marketplace gateway adapter pilot with LangChain/LlamaIndex hooks. Goals: 1) marketplace listing on partner portal 2) validated adapter w/ orchestrator 3) joint announcement window. Ping @keiko for build updates.
keiko: On it. Docker image almost ready. Using tag `redwood/gateway-adapter:hw-pilot-2026-03-19`. I pushed a test manifest to sandbox: `s3://redwood-internal/hw-pilot/manifest.yaml`.
taylor: Confirmed partner (WaveCompute) wants a marketplace SKU and a private trial region. I have a contact (elaine@wavecompute). Need pricing band and trial quotas.
anya: Marketing/PR note — avoid public mention until partners sign off. Target embargo lift: 2026-04-05. I'll draft assets once we have a feature matrix + screenshots. Link to doc: https://docs.google.com/.../hw-pilot-assets
keiko: Quick compatibility checklist (local):
```
- supports cuda-compat v12
- quantized model bundles (q4f16)
- health probe /ready -> 200
- certs: KMS integration test
```
partner-bot: CI: adapter-build passed (linux, cuda12), unit tests: 124/124 ✅ — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3421
sam: Nice. For integration smoke tests, can we run LangChain orchestration flow? Example script:
```
python tests/smoke_langchain.py --adapter-url https://sandbox.gateway.redwood/hw-pilot
```
keiko: Yes. I added a minimal `llm_adapter.py` shim that implements `call_adapter(prompt)` — pushing to branch `hw/pilot-integration`.
mike: Ops — we'll need a private VPC deploy for the partner trial. @taylor can you confirm region (us-west2)? Also, add an autoscale cap to avoid OOM spikes: `MAX_INSTANCES=4`.
taylor: us-west2 confirmed. I'll coordinate with partner for access. Also adding marketplace metadata: icons, feature tags, trial_duration=30d.
anya: PR checklist for announcement: 1) partner sign-off 2) joint blog draft 3) marketing assets 4) sync with legal for logo use 5) scheduled demo. I'll pull legal in: @keiko can you DM legal contacts?
keiko: Yep. DMing legal now. Also attaching short demo video recording path: `gs://redwood-assets/hw-pilot/demo-clip.mp4`.
sam: Next steps: keiko finish integration tests by EOD Thursday (1748009000), taylor finalize marketplace SKU + pricing by Monday, anya prepare embargoed blog draft by next Wed. Quick thumbs if that works.
mike: 👍
keiko: 👍 will do
partner-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled — Pilot sync 2026-03-21 10:00 PDT — calendar invite sent.
sam: Thanks everyone — let's keep questions here. If partner needs early access to logs, create a shared role in the sandbox and tag `partner-wavecompute`.
keiko: created role `role/partner-wavecompute-access` with limited S3 + CloudWatch read. Tests running now.
taylor: I’ll send the marketplace draft to Elaine and cc legal.
anya: perfect. :thumbsup:
sam: closing thread for now, will open new thread for press once we have sign-off.
